primary_hypothesis.falsifier: lp_gt(c) > lp_best(c) on at least half the usable cells of at least half the in-support systems, with the family-clustered 95% lower bound of P1 above 0.5
primary_hypothesis.never_measured_before: C0001 Part C ran under a Gate B->C violation; C2-P was never computed; that phase3/ is INADMISSIBLE. This is a first measurement, not a rerun.

certificate_basis.source: Stahlberg & Byrne, EMNLP-IJCNLP 2019, pp. 3356-3362, DOI 10.18653/v1/D19-1331, §2 p.3357 gamma <= log P(y_hat|x); Alg.1 line 12 is an argmax over the returned set

bias_audit_battery.rationale: three mechanisms bias the read toward E2, the campaign's preferred answer; F-g adds a fourth of unknown direction. An E2 attribution that does not clear this battery is reported as E2_direction_observed_but_confounded, which is NOT a supported E2.

BA1.mechanism: T=0.1 upper-tail sampling makes lp_best a tight bound on L*, so G>B is hard to trip; beam_type='sampling' and beam_temperature=0.1 are the CHECKPOINT'S OWN stored defaults
BA1.consequence: median >= 0.95 => the attribution is reported as E2_conditional_on_near_greedy_reference in every artifact

BA2.mechanism: summed log-probability is length-confounded — D19-1331's own central finding — and Hill truths are token-longer than the polynomial candidates that dominate the realized vocabulary
BA2.measurement: sb_best_len(c) = 1[lp_gt(c) > max over usable candidates with |len - len_gt| <= round(0.20 * len_gt)]
BA2.consequence: partner-available rate < 0.5 => length_control_not_measurable, reported; where partners exist, direction disagreement on >20% of those cells => E2_direction_observed_but_confounded
BA2.forbidden: length normalization breaks the monotonicity that makes gamma admissible (D19-1331 §2); no normalized variant may replace the raw certificate

BA3.mechanism: a single-encoding lp_gt is a lower bound on the truth's probability
BA3.consequence: encoding_flip_rate > 0.05 => the single-encoding read is invalid and only the logsumexp read is reportable

BA4.mechanism: the generation conditioning is not the scoring conditioning (F-g); direction unknown
BA4.measurement: S1 — P1 and P2 recomputed in C_raw
BA4.consequence: context disagreement on the attribution => verdict conditioning_sensitive and NOTHING is attributed

declared_limitation_no_design_can_remove.fact: F-h — the decoder's emitted token sequence is unrecoverable, so lp_best in either context is the score of a RE-SPELLING
declared_limitation_no_design_can_remove.what_survives: lp_best <= L* holds for the maximum over any set of complete sequences, so both certificates survive
declared_limitation_no_design_can_remove.what_does_not: any claim that lp_best equals the model score the decoder assigned to its own output

permitted: sb_best is a CERTIFIED LOWER BOUND on the search-error rate under the preregistered scoring context. It is not an estimate of it. D19-1331's own Beam-100 still shows 53.62% search errors against the exact global argmax, so an approximation built on a returned set systematically UNDERCOUNTS search errors.
me_best = 1 certifies that the truth is NOT the model's argmax under this conditioning.
forbidden: any sentence of the form 'the search-error rate is X' citing D19-1331; the paper defines search errors against the exact global argmax from DFS (footnote 5, p. 3358) and never performs a reference-versus-returned comparison under any decoding procedure
'the truth has negligible probability mass under the model' — the G<B branch bounds NOTHING about mass; rule 01 item 8
any claim that more search WOULD find the truth on the strength of G>B; D19-1331's central result is that the exact global best can be degenerate (51.8% empty translations, BLEU 2.1)

The deliverable is primarily the per-system partition, which is well defined regardless of interval width.

rules.disposition: excluded from lp_best, retained with failure_reason
excluded from the comparison distribution, counted
excluded from P1/P2, reported; >10% of cells => undecidable
member dropped, counted; <=20% or Gate 3c fails
counted, excluded from both sb_best and me_best, reported
recorded as equals_raw: null, never coerced

artifact_contract.run_id_rule: gpu_runclaude1_c0002_<short7> from the freezing commit; if the directory exists append _v2; never overwrite (rule 05)
artifact_contract.provenance: scripts/ops/run_manifest.py records git commit and branch, pip freeze, GPU and driver, checkpoint SHA256, and a recursive data-tree fingerprint
artifact_contract.large_artifacts: need not be committed; hashes and paths preserved (rule 05)

three_way_distinction_at_endpoint_name_l.oracle: lp_best and every endpoint built on it are ORACLE quantities over the generated set

selected.reason: no per-candidate decoder score is stored (F-e); candidate_index==0 is the highest-input-R2 candidate (F-f), not a decoder argmax

what_cannot_change.trigger: no final test is accessed this cycle, so the binding instant is the computation of the first primary indicator of the frozen run
frozen_at_that_instant: the primary hypothesis and its falsifier
the primary endpoint and its decision rule
the scoring contexts and which is primary
the admissible-encoding enumeration and its cap
the control battery and every control threshold
the H0010 predicates and the n_class_joint >= 6 falsifier
what_cannot_change.absolutely_forbidden: raising a threshold to rescue a result (rule 01 item 3)

deviation_policy.mechanism: a dated DEVIATION-nn block appended to a successor version, naming what changed, why, who decided, and what it invalidates

reduced_designs.RD1: single context (C_gen only); BA4 reported not_measurable and the E2 wording correspondingly qualified
reduced_designs.RD2: the 24-system fixed GRN validation panel instead of 71 systems; P1/P2 reported exploratory and attributing nothing
reduced_designs.RD3: H0010 census restricted to the realized classes without multiplicity weighting (H4 dropped)

deviation_policy.named_contingency: if the C_gen reconstruction fails Gate 4, C_raw becomes primary AND every E3 statement is downgraded to 'the truth outscores all 50 candidates under a conditioning the search did not see', which is not a search-error claim

fires_on: an E2 or E3 corpus attribution
any result an independent reviewer marks fragile
any result resting on a single seed or a single context
minimum_change_at_least_one_independent_: a fresh process and artifact path
an independent re-derivation of lp_best from a separately written scorer

unimplementable_as_stated.item: could_not_evaluate on a deterministic node/operation budget
unimplementable_as_stated.finding: a genuine operation-count or iteration budget INSIDE a SymPy call does not exist and cannot be added without patching SymPy; egg's runners have it, SymPy has no analogue
unimplementable_as_stated.what_is_implemented_instead: a count_ops ADMISSION bound plus a seeded RNG plus three-valued recording, with the wall clock demoted to a crash-safety net whose firing is a separate counted label that must be 0
unimplementable_as_stated.weaker_because: it makes admission deterministic, not termination
unimplementable_as_stated.egg_is_cited_as: the precedent for the PROPERTY (an outcome that is a function of the inputs alone), not as an available mechanism

unimplementable_as_stated.item: Schwartz-Zippel numerical certificate as a declared arbitration procedure
unimplementable_as_stated.finding: not adopted; the bound is stated for polynomials over a field and the GRN skeletons are rational functions with variable denominators; the clearing-of-denominators and pole-avoidance argument is not established in any primary source (literature §Q7 item 6)

unimplementable_as_stated.item: realized denominators known by construction for BOTH hypotheses
unimplementable_as_stated.finding: true for H0001-R (verified 71/852/42593); NOT true as stated for H0010 — the 846/89349/879 counts are prose plus a session-scoped scratchpad, not an archived artifact
unimplementable_as_stated.response: Gate 2 converts this into a gating census computed before the endpoint

unimplementable_as_stated.finding: FALSE (F-f); it is the highest-input-R2 candidate
unimplementable_as_stated.effect_on_the_conclusion: the conclusion that it cannot serve as lp_sel is unchanged and strengthened, but the stated reason in the design brief and the independent review is wrong; the disposition of MAJOR-R5 in the light of it belongs to the supervisor

unimplementable_as_stated.status: the largest single validity limitation of the cycle
